values.note: Water spigots through the loop (shut off Oct 31). No flush toilets or showers in Oak Point; campers may use the camper services building (showers, flush toilets) in Early Settlers campground. The park's dump station closes Oct 31.

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead; a vehicle pass must be displayed. 14 days in any 28-day period; six people, two vehicles and one camping unit per site.

values.note: Oak Point basic sites $28 a night (late October 2026; June 2027, Saturday the same). CPW's park page gives campsites at $20-$36 by type and season. A daily vehicle pass ($10-$12 with Colorado plates, $15-$17 without) or an annual pass is required on top; CPW's reservation fee is charged per stay.

flags: Split question: the evidence points to Oak Point being a SEPARATE campground from Aspen Grove (2286) and Early Settlers (2285). Its site centroid (39.2317,-107.7885) is ~1.3 km from Aspen Grove's (39.2221,-107.7796) and ~2.5 km from Early Settlers' across the reservoir; OSM shows Oak Point's own campground roads entering from the north (off Vega Vista Drive / Big Elk Drive near 39.2350,-107.7897), while Aspen Grove is reached from CR 64.6 / N.6 Road near the visitor center. CPW names it a campground ('Oak Point and Aspen Grove Campgrounds'), though cpwshop lists every loop under one park (parkID 50045).
